description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Ice], [High Runic] and [Arcane Blade] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: High Runic
description.text: Taunts single-target BLK and WHT attacks, absorbs BLK and WHT attacks to restore 1 consumed ability use

description.name: Arcane Blade
description.text: Grants [Physical High Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the front row after using a Ice ability
